findings.title: Physical node_modules runtime and type closures are silently omitted
findings.observed: Three negative fixtures return API PASS with empty violations/diagnostics and CLI exit0. Both runtime fixtures exit0 and print PRODUCT_LOADED; the type fixture resolves through index.d.mts to products/shift/src/types.d.mts.
findings.cause: localTarget only adds an edge and enqueues source when the real physical target does not contain /node_modules/. Ordinary installed packages and their declarations are discarded without INCOMPLETE. Symlinked packages that realpath outside node_modules do not exercise this branch.

findings.title: Node22 process-derived loader capabilities bypass checking
findings.observed: process.getBuiltinModule(module).createRequire loader aliases and process.mainModule.require return API PASS and CLI exit0 while loading the synthetic product. Two identical process-derived unknown-target sources return PASS for both product and neutral runtime targets, instead of INCOMPLETE.
findings.cause: Module namespaces are seeded from known imports or tracked require calls; process.getBuiltinModule and process.mainModule loader hosts are not classified. Their loader invocations and nonliteral targets escape the reference visitor.
